title: 第15章 童养夫与未婚妻第16章 天帝第一百二十一条不存在的帝脉
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
萧家内院深处，有关一场令两家都激动的联姻仪式正在举行中。
左边是萧家一众族老汇聚于此，而右边则是只有人数稀少的叶家四人。
当两家互相呈递婚书，盖上印章的刹那，两家人脸上都是露出难以忘怀的开心笑容。
叶家是知道从此叶天澜的资源不用发愁了，纵使他想要天上的星星，估计萧战天都要找人搭梯子爬上去摘。
而萧家就更不用多说了，虽然这孩子不是亲生的，但跟半个萧家人甚至和核心萧家人没区别。
这么小的孩子正是培养感情的最佳时候，只要给他好的，对他真诚，那养大了不照样视若己出吗？
平白无故得了一个拥有大帝资的后辈，他们这些老不死的以后怎么也得封个从龙之功吧？
一众族老乐呵的简直合不拢嘴，后槽牙都快咧出来了。
“三哥，你别说我已经开始期待起来了。”
“期待什么？当然是期待咱们萧家名震大陆的时候啊。”
“五弟严肃些，你别这样想，不然我嘴角真的笑得都快压不住了，嘿嘿嘿。”
“六妹呢？你这是在干嘛？”
“我在看我家中还有哪些好的灵药适合小天修行。”
“好好好，你这么干是吧？我直接把我家那口千年寒玉床搬来。”
“不是我靠，二哥，你这么不讲武德？”
······
在一众族老互相攀比着准备给叶天澜什么礼物培养感情的时候，萧战天也是将目光放到了底下的两个孩子身上。
洛珺仙虽然只有十五六岁，但少女身姿婀娜窈窕，倩影动人，盈盈柳腰不堪一握，只用一根淡黄色的缎带束着，俏脸上早已初具风华绝代之姿。
半个月大的叶天澜在她旁边站着立刻就有一种大姐姐与小弟弟的既视感。
也是怕洛珺仙心中有芥蒂，他安慰提醒道：

“仙儿，虽然小天现在还小，但修炼无岁月，我辈武者年龄相差几十岁是很正常的事情，像咱们天香国的国主，他的发妻便是曾经教导他的导师。”
那这导师还挺风韵犹存的啊。
叶天澜睁大了眼睛，在心中默默想道。
“好了，爷爷，我知道，我会等他长大的。”洛珺仙声音难得不再冷冰冰，稍微柔和了些许。
既然这是她自己的选择，她便不再后悔。
纵使这家伙长大之后再怎么难看，品行再怎么差劲···
不行，长得难看就服用丹药整改，品行差就要好好的教育他，绝对不能长歪了！
她小脸清冷肃穆的看着这个小小的童养夫。
叶天澜心有所感，歪头抬起来好奇的看着自己的这个大大的童养妻。
心头一咯噔，怎么莫名感觉这个仙儿姐姐的眼神好像严肃的有些不对劲是怎么回事？
······
两年半后。
白雪如同柳絮从天空之上洋洋洒洒的飘落而下，院落之中，高墙之上早已积上了厚厚的一层皑皑白雪，墙角处光秃秃的树干上也是银装素裹。
天地间只剩下茫茫一片。
与冷冽森寒，潇潇洒洒的剑光。
洛珺仙一袭青衣白裙，身姿曼妙，步伐飘逸如同雪中精灵。
大雪为她青丝增添了一抹雪白，与越发成熟动人的小脸相得益彰，绽放出一股如同雪中傲梅般惊心动魄的美。
半晌之后，她停止了舞剑。
随后收起剑招，负手持剑而立，蹙着眉头看向依旧紧闭着，毫无动静的房门。
content_en:
Deep in the inner courtyard of the Xiao family, a marriage ceremony that excited both families was being held.
On the left are all the elders of the Xiao family gathered here, while on the right are only four members of the Ye family who are few in number.
When the two families presented their marriage certificates to each other and stamped the seals, the faces of both families showed unforgettable happy smiles.
The Ye family knew that from now on Ye Tianlan would not have to worry about his resources. Even if he wanted the stars in the sky, Xiao Zhantian would probably have to find someone to build a ladder to climb up and pick them.
Needless to say, the Xiao family, although this child is not biological, is no different from half of the Xiao family or even the core Xiao family.
Such a young child is the best time to cultivate feelings. As long as you give him good things and be sincere to him, won't you still treat him as your own when you grow up?
I got a junior who has the qualifications of a great emperor for no reason. How can they, the immortals, be granted the title of "Serving the Dragon" in the future?
The elders of the clan were so happy that their back teeth were almost sticking out.
"Third brother, don't tell me that I'm already looking forward to it."
"What are you looking forward to? Of course, we are looking forward to the time when our Xiao family will become famous in the mainland."
"Fifth brother, be serious, don't think like this, otherwise I will be laughing so hard that I can hardly hold back my laughter, hehehehe."
"Where's Sixth Sister? What are you doing?"
"I'm looking at what other good elixirs I have at home that are suitable for Xiaotian's practice."
"Okay, okay, that's what you're doing, right? I'll just bring that thousand-year-old jade bed from my house."
"Damn it, second brother, are you so ungrateful in martial arts?"
······
While the clan elders were competing with each other to prepare gifts for Ye Tianlan to cultivate their relationship, Xiao Zhantian also set his sights on the two children below.
Although Luo Junxian is only fifteen or sixteen years old, the girl has a graceful figure, a charming figure, a slim waist that cannot be grasped, and is only tied with a light yellow ribbon. Her pretty face has already begun to take on an unparalleled look.
Half-month-old Ye Tianlan stood next to her and immediately felt like a big sister and a little brother.
Also afraid that Luo Junxian might have a grudge in his heart, he comforted and reminded:
"Xian'er, although Xiaotian is still young now, he has not practiced for many years. It is normal for warriors of our generation to have an age difference of several dozen years. For example, the leader of our Tianxiang Kingdom, his first wife is the mentor who once taught him."
Then this instructor still has a lot of charm.
Ye Tianlan opened his eyes wide and thought silently in his heart.
"Okay, grandpa, I know, I will wait for him to grow up." Luo Junxian's voice was rare and no longer cold, and became slightly softer.
Since this was her own choice, she no longer regretted it.
No matter how ugly this guy is when he grows up, no matter how bad his conduct is...
No, if he looks ugly, he should take pills to correct it. If he has bad conduct, he should be educated well. He must not grow crooked!
Her little face looked at this little child supporter with a cold and solemn expression.
Ye Tianlan felt something. He tilted his head and raised his head to look curiously at his big child adoptive wife.
My heart skipped a beat. Why did I feel like there was something wrong with the serious look in Sister Xian'er's eyes?
······
Two and a half years later.
White snow is falling from the sky like catkins. In the courtyard, a thick layer of white snow has already accumulated on the high wall, and the bare tree trunks at the corners are also covered in silver.
There is only a vast expanse left between heaven and earth.
With the cold and cold, the light of the sword is unrestrained.
Luo Junxian is dressed in a blue robe and white skirt, with a graceful figure and graceful steps like an elf in the snow.
The heavy snow added a touch of white to her black hair, which complemented her increasingly mature and charming little face, blooming with a breathtaking beauty like a proud plum in the snow.
After a while, she stopped dancing with her sword.
Then he put away his sword moves and stood with the sword behind his back. He frowned and looked at the door, which was still closed and motionless.
